chunks: And from him, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the qunut that a man forgets, and he said: He should perform qunut after he bows in ruku'. If he does not remember until he finishes and departs, then there is nothing upon him.

key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplicatory act performed in prayer at its prescribed place
key_terms.فَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: no liability or required make-up remains upon him
key_terms.يَنْسَاهُ: forgets it or omits it unintentionally
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفَ: he finishes and departs from the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the qunut in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the qunut in salat. If he remembers after ruku', he performs it then; if he only remembers after finishing the prayer, nothing is required of him.
